description: A compound lower-body exercise where you lower your hips down and back, then stand back up, targeting the legs and glutes.
A chest-focused exercise where you press a barbell or dumbbells from your chest while lying on a bench.
A full-body movement where you lift a barbell from the ground to a standing position, emphasizing the posterior chain.
A bodyweight exercise where you pull yourself up to a bar using upper body strength, primarily targeting the back and biceps.
A back-strengthening exercise where you pull a barbell toward your torso while maintaining a bent-over position.
A biceps isolation exercise where you curl dumbbells upward while keeping your elbows stable.
A variation of the biceps curl where you hold dumbbells with a neutral grip, emphasizing the brachialis muscle.
A chest exercise similar to the bench press, but using dumbbells for a greater range of motion.
A chest-focused exercise performed on an inclined bench to target the upper pectoral muscles.
A shoulder exercise where you press a barbell or dumbbells overhead from shoulder height.
A shoulder isolation exercise where you lift dumbbells outward to the sides to target the lateral delts.
A variation of the deadlift that focuses on the hamstrings and glutes by keeping a slight knee bend while hinging at the hips.
A single-leg squat variation where one foot is elevated behind you, targeting the quads and glutes.
A lower-leg exercise where you rise onto your toes to strengthen the calf muscles.
